By entering my name below and submitting this form I acknowledge that I reviewed and understand the OCC Vehicle Use Policy and Procedure.

I hereby authorize all public record repository records relating to my driving records, if any, to be released to Oakland Community College (“OCC”). I acknowledge that OCC has made a full and complete disclosure of its intention to obtain such reports on me as required by law. I further understand and acknowledge that should I hold a position that requires me to operate a motor vehicle as part of my essential job duties, OCC, through the Human Resources Department, will perform periodic checks of my driving record.
